tagline.en: Food Science PhD candidate · Flavor chemistry and machine learning
tagline.zh: 食品科学博士在读 · 风味化学与机器学习

bio.en: I'm a Food Science PhD candidate at Jiangnan University, with joint PhD training at the National University of Singapore, graduating in June 2027. My work combines flavor chemistry and machine learning: GC-MS and GC-O analysis, sensory evaluation, and models that predict perception from molecules. During my PhD I built a GC-MS data processing system that has handled more than 3,000 samples. The tools below run directly in your browser.
bio.zh: 江南大学食品科学与工程博士在读，在新加坡国立大学联合培养，2027 年 6 月毕业。我的研究把风味化学和机器学习结合起来，包括 GC-MS / GC-O 分析、感官评价，以及从分子预测感知的模型。读博期间我开发了一套 GC-MS 数据处理系统，已处理 3000 多个样品。下面的工具都可以直接在浏览器里使用。
